name: Donald C. Evans, Jr.
tagline: Top rated Eminent Domain attorney in Cartersville, Georgia
education: University of Georgia School of Law
about: Donald C. Evans Jr. is the founding attorney of Evans Law Firm in Cartersville, Georgia. He concentrates his practice on eminent domain, criminal defense and general litigation. A native of Cartersville, he brings both local insight and statewide reach to his representation of clients, particularly in cases involving the protection of private property rights.

Mr. Evans has built a reputation as one of Georgia’s leading attorneys in eminent domain matters, advocating for families whose land is targeted by utility companies such as Georgia Power and Georgia Transmission Corporation. His practice spans more than 50 counties across the state, including Bartow, Barrow, Cobb, Coweta, Forsyth, Gordon, Gwinnett, Hall, Jackson, Oconee and Washington counties. Through his dedication and skill, he has become a trusted advocate for landowners seeking to defend their rights against powerful interests.

After completing Mr. Evans’ undergraduate degree in political science at The University of the South in Sewanee, Tennessee, he earned his law degree magna cum laude from the University of Georgia School of Law. He began his legal career as a law clerk to a prominent federal district court judge in Rome, Georgia, where he gained invaluable experience in the workings of the federal judiciary.

In his home county of Bartow, Mr. Evans has repeatedly set benchmarks in civil litigation, securing the largest jury verdicts in the county’s history on three separate occasions. These record-setting outcomes underscore his commitment to delivering exceptional results for his clients, even in the most challenging cases.

With a practice defined by strategic preparation, courtroom excellence and an unwavering commitment to justice, Mr. Evans continues to stand out as a respected trial lawyer and defender of individual rights throughout Georgia.
